_comment: Chance that each scout survives reaching a wave, per front (its unit's `stealth` scales the chance of being caught: 1 - (1 - survival) x stealth). Scouts of every kind can go together, at the pace of the slowest; assassins among the survivors may kill the horde's leader (units.json `scouting.assassinate`). An army with scouts fights the better for knowing the enemy: `intel.perPoint` attack and defense for each point of its scouts' intel, at most `intel.max`. Report tiers by the surviving scouts' intel (units.json `scouting.intel`; minSurvivors is in intel): sizeError / unitError are the relative width of the ranges reported (0 = exact). revealsStance: the report includes the wave's battle stance. Scouts can also search for ruins: `ruinSearch.minScouts` or more leave the village for `ruinSearch.hours` game hours, and when they are back they have found a forgotten ruin (a new ancient site within `ruinSearch.range` hexes of the village, on free ground that suits a kind of site, at least `ruinSearch.spacing` from other sites) with a chance of `chancePerScout` per scout, at most `maxChance`.
